candidates.approval_note: ENV-ALL1 CANDIDATE INTAKE ONLY. Drive 1b8jYAdg2wyxrcgAeddZ5eW4KBzzO78ux, filename IMG_5189.JPG. The bytes measured here are the copy already preserved in this repository by the P95 recent-Drive sweep at art/references/candidates/recent-drive-sweep/source-images/IMG_5189.JPG; the repository filename is deliberately NOT changed, because renaming preserved source bytes is not an intake step. The P95 sweep classified it NEW_PRODUCTION_SOURCE_CANDIDATE and described it as an empty executive-office environment candidate. This lane completes the intake AX-92B1 ran for two of the six environment candidates and left undone for the other four; park and press room were not a cap. WHY THIS ONE MATTERS: at 5504px it clears the 4608px environment master minimum that the banked OCD_SCENE_MASTER_EXECUTIVE_PRIVATE_OFFICE_1672x941_01.png fails, so it is the direct answer to open asset request 'env-executive-office-4k-master'. That is a statement about pixel width, NOT an owner acceptance and NOT a style-family ruling. No family_id is declared: which environment family this serves, and what the World would call the place, are decisions nobody has made, and intake must not infer either from the picture or from a filename. native_detail_state is 'unverified' because nothing in this project establishes whether the 5504px render is native detail or an external enlargement. No owner approval is recorded, so approved_by is absent rather than invented. Accepting the art would close only the art half of the executive gap: resolvePlayerCapabilities still has no executive capability, so no life could reach the room.
